meta.titleDefault: Itnyang - the Korean community in France
meta.description: Itnyang is where Koreans in France buy and sell second-hand, find a room or a job, and help each other with everyday questions.

write.menuLabel: What would you like to post?

footer.safetyNote: Meet in person, in a public place. Never send money before you have seen the item or the room.

suspended.message: Because of a rules violation, posting, messaging and photo uploads are blocked on this account.
suspended.messageUntil: Because of a rules violation, posting, messaging and photo uploads are blocked on this account until {date}.

market.title: Buy and sell
market.body: Moving out or heading home: trade face to face with neighbours.

housing.title: Find a room
housing.body: Flatshares, studios, summer sublets. Never pay before a viewing.

job.title: Find work
job.body: Restaurants, tutoring, interpreting. Check the pay and contract before applying.

community.title: Ask a question
community.body: Residence permit, CAF, banks: people who have been there answer.
community.count: {count, plural, one {# question waiting} other {# questions waiting}}

checklist.title: Just arrived in France? ✈︎
checklist.lead: What to sort out in your first weeks. Stuck? Ask someone who has done it.
checklist.dismissed: Checklist hidden. You can bring it back from My account.

visa.title: Residence permit
visa.body: Depending on your visa, you need to validate it online or apply for a residence permit (ANEF) after arriving.

bank.title: Bank account
bank.body: Rent, salary and CAF all need a RIB (bank details).

phone.title: Phone plan
phone.body: Many start with a prepaid SIM and switch to a monthly plan.

caf.title: Housing and CAF
caf.body: Once housed, check whether you can get housing benefit (APL).

health.title: Health insurance
health.body: Register with Ameli and choose a GP (médecin traitant).

transport.title: Transport
transport.body: Get a Navigo pass; students under 26 can get the Imagine R discount.

feed.title: Latest from neighbours
feed.lead: Questions, stories, rooms and jobs, newest first.
feed.empty: Nothing new in this area yet.

recent.title: New listings
recent.lead: Moving-out sales and more, newest first.

trust.title: Built for trust
trust.lead: Problems are hard to fix abroad, so we focus on preventing them.

verified.title: Verified members
verified.body: Only members with a verified email can post and chat. Housing and job posts open after 7 days.

reports.title: Reports act fast
reports.body: A post reported 3 times is hidden until a moderator checks it, and you can block anyone in chat.

scams.title: Scam warnings
scams.body: Advance payments, moving to other messengers, pay below minimum wage: we warn you as you post.

cta.title: Meet Koreans across France
cta.lead: Signing up takes a minute. Everything is free.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or the address is wrong.
